entities.name: Theodore Thomson Flynn
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Theodore Thomson Flynn MRIA was an Australian-British zoologist and marine biologist and a professor in both Tasmania and the United Kingdom. He was the first biology professor in Tasmania. Flynn was the father of the actor Errol Flynn.
